title: Conflicting revisions
prompt:
Manual revision 4 says max upload 20 MB. Revision 5 replaces revision 4 and says 50 MB. An old FAQ repeats 20 MB. Only revision 5 is authoritative. Return max_upload_mb. Return only valid JSON with exactly these fields: max_upload_mb. Numeric values must be JSON numbers; boolean values must be JSON booleans; absent values null. No extra fields.

Write that JSON, and nothing else, to answer.json in the current directory.
acceptance: answer.json equals the gold answer under Abdul's equality rule
